about: What is new in the next release, as the Studio shows it after an update and in its update banner. tools/release/make_release_json.py copies this into release.json. Keep it to a handful of lines a user can act on; page is a Studio page (the palette's module name, e.g. semicrystalline, or a command id such as module.open thermal). The full changelog stays in tools/docs/src/whatsnew.md.
title: November 2026 update

highlights.title: Semicrystalline stacks of every library polymer
highlights.detail: Lamellar cells of PE, PVDF, PTFE, iPP, PEO, POM, PLLA, the nylons, PET and natural rubber, with amorphous layers grown from each polymer's own repeat unit.

highlights.title: Powder patterns, measured and calculated
highlights.detail: I(2θ) of any periodic cell, Rietveld and Pawley fits to instrument files, indexing and phase fractions. Find it under Analyze, on the Scattering page.

highlights.title: Crystal properties from the force field
highlights.detail: Phonons, quasi-harmonic thermal expansion, dielectric, piezoelectric and optical tensors, Z-method melting points and crystal habits.

highlights.title: More polymer architectures
highlights.detail: Copolymers of several units with composition drift, grafts on chosen sites, AB_n dendrimers and hyperbranched molecules.

highlights.title: Sorption with bending molecules
highlights.detail: Oils, plasticisers and curatives grow in at their rotatable bonds, with a held loading, and a pore network reports channels, percolation and limiting diameters.

highlights.title: Fit a force field to a crystal
highlights.detail: Parameters fitted to structure, lattice energy and elastic constants, plus QEq charges for periodic fillers.

highlights.title: Cells too small for their bonds are caught
highlights.detail: A small crystal cell gave badly wrong energies without warning. Energy and relaxation now use enough copies, and dynamics stops and names the supercell it needs.
